newsitem.title: INDIA: Search teams find "black boxes" of Kazakh plane.
newsitem.headline: Search teams find "black boxes" of Kazakh plane.

text.p: Search teams found the flight data and cockpit voice recorders of a Kazakh Airlines cargo plane which collided in mid-air with a Saudi Arabian jumbo passenger jet, an airline official said on Wednesday.

Rajiv Bhaskar, of Kazakh Airlines, told Reuters the two "black boxes" were found in the wreckage of the Ilyushin IL-76 after the world's worst mid-air collision on Tuesday in which some 350 people are believed to have died.

Bhaskar said the plane was carrying 27 passengers, including two children, and 10 crew. Officials in Kazakh capital Almaty had said earlier the plane was carrying 39 people. There were 312 people aboard the Saudi Arabian Airlines Boeing 747.
The passengers on board the Kazakh plane were businessmen who had chartered the aircraft to New Delhi where they were to buy Indian goods and transport them back home, Bhaskar said.
He said businessmen chartered planes from Almaty regularly for trips to India.
